chunks: What Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from his father, who said:

I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام about a man who forgot the adhan and the iqamah until he had entered into the salat. He said: Let him continue in his salat, for the adhan is only a sunnah (prophetic tradition).

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام, the authority being asked for the ruling
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer already entered into
key_terms.الْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer made before the salat
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةَ: the second call immediately before commencing the salat
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: a recommended prophetic practice, not an obligatory element that invalidates the salat if omitted
key_terms.فَلْيَمْضِ: let him proceed and continue without stopping

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets the adhan and iqamah and has already started salat, should he continue or restart?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgets the adhan and iqamah until after beginning the salat. Imam Aba Ja'far عليه السلام instructs that he should continue the prayer, indicating that the adhan is sunnah (prophetic tradition) and not something whose omission invalidates the prayer.
